> ### ⛔⛔ **SUPERSESSION IN PLACE — item 1 of the addendum above (dated 2026-08-06, `doc-curator-c2w6-fold-2`, from `c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §3.1 + erratum banner 2 + Add.9 §A27.1). ⛔ The addendum body above is NOT rewritten and NOTHING in it is deleted; item 1's FRAMING is replaced, and this is an UPGRADE, not a retraction.**
>
> ⛔⛔ **WHAT IS WITHDRAWN (framing only, no number):** item 1's headline ***"THE PREMISE IS RETIRED"***, and with it the replacement wording it recommended — ***"N223's monotone collapse does not reproduce at the run-2 config"*** — are **BOTH NEVER-QUOTE as of 2026-08-06.** ⚠ **Stated explicitly so a future reader sees the chain rather than a silent swap: the second wording was the Advisor's own approved replacement for the first, and it has since been withdrawn too** (the Hub's own `[C2W6]` never-quote list recommended it; corrected at every site in the handover doc at `[C2W6-CLOSE]`).
>
> ⭐⭐ **WHAT REPLACES IT — the curves, not their endpoints (`c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §3.1, POST-HOC and labelled: a description of the registered curve, never a re-scoring).** On `p1_off` the depth **falls hard and then partly recovers**:
>
> | `p1_off` seed | untrained | **trough (step)** | **min ÷ untrained** | at step 200 | final | final ÷ min |
> |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
> | 0 | 4.63e-02 | 4.12e-04 (**step 150**) | **0.0089 — a 112× loss** | 6.39e-04 | 6.25e-03 | 15.2× |
> | 1 | 1.62e-01 | 1.62e-01 (step 0 — **no dip**) | 1.000 | 3.31e-01 | 2.99e-01 | 1.85× |
> | 2 | 2.49e-01 | 1.32e-02 (**step 275**) | **0.0532 — a 19× loss** | 6.59e-02 | 3.50e-02 | 2.64× |
> | | | | **geo 0.0779, log-mean/SE −1.85** | geo 0.196 (−1.13 SE) | geo 0.327 (−1.29 SE) | **geo 4.20×** |
>
> ⭐ **It is NOT a minimum-of-noise artifact:** reading-to-reading noise over the last 400 steps is **1.33× / 1.10× / 1.05×** (median |Δln depth|), **two orders of magnitude** smaller than the 112× and 19× excursions, and seed 1's argmin is at step 0.
>
> ⭐⭐ **THE RECONCILIATION, which is the whole point: the banked N223 anchor was taken at 200 outer steps — INSIDE the transient trough** (troughs at steps 150 and 275 on the two seeds that dip). **So E1's registered statistic (`final ÷ step-200`) had its DENOMINATOR sitting in the trough on 2/3 seeds, which is mechanically why it read 9.782 and 0.5305: E1 was structurally measuring RECOVERY-FROM-THE-TROUGH, not decay.**
>
> ✅ **THE DEFENSIBLE RECORD, and the only approved form: *"N223's mechanism FIRES at the run-2 config but is NOT TERMINAL."*** ⭐ **This RESTORES N223 as a live mechanism** rather than leaving it retired — erosion at the run-2 config is **real and transient**. ✅ **The estimator-robust survivor is the COMPARATIVE claim (§3's real R1): *"erosion tracks uselessness"*** — the residual-off corner erodes **significantly** (geo **0.0775×**, log-mean/SE **−3.10**) while the run-2 arm does not (geo 0.327×, −1.29 SE, n.s.), a **4.2× separation** (N225).
>
> ⛔⛔ **WHAT DOES *NOT* MOVE, stated so this is never read as a re-scoring:** **E1 remains REFUTED 0/3** (raw **and** decay-netted), the **gate verdict `FAILS_FLATTEN` is unchanged**, and **§A23.2's re-scope premise (the BASELINE failed E1, not P1) is independently confirmed.** ⛔ **The Advisor re-derived all 21 records from raw with worst relative deviation 0.00e+00 — zero transcription error was found anywhere in this wave.**
>
> ⛔ **ALSO NEVER-QUOTE (unchanged from item 1, and now with its statistics):** *"0.708 ± 0.57× — the store does not decay, it RECOVERS"*. The direction is **not significant under EITHER estimator** (arith 0.708 ± 0.570 = **0.51 SE** from 1; geo **0.327**, log-mean/SE **−1.29**) and **the two estimators disagree in direction on the same three seeds** ⇒ any sentence asserting a direction is estimator-dependent and therefore not a finding.
>
> ⚠ **NEW INSTRUMENT CAVEAT (A1) ON THIS ENTRY'S OWN CURVE — no verdict moves.** The erosion curve is **RAW: it is not netted of the designed decay**, and the decay's exponent **DRIFTS** because `last_write_chunk` moves **0→12 within one slot** across a run (6–10 distinct values per slot), so each reading carries a different designed-decay factor `exp(−0.04·(15−c))`. ⭐ **The law itself is EXACT** — predicted per-tick relative depth drop **0.039211** vs harness-measured median **0.039211** (min 0.039210, max 0.039211) over **717** readings — and the own-leg residual against `D·group_scale²` is ≤ **3.324e-07** (float32 ULP). **Netting it out moves E1 at seed 0 from 9.78× → 6.47× (−34 %)**, i.e. **up to a third of the apparent "recovery" is ALLOCATOR DRIFT toward later write chunks, not depth restoration**, and `final/untrained` moves 0.1351 → 0.0858 there. ⛔ **Direction is conservative — netting makes the arm look MORE eroded, never less — so no C2W6 verdict changes (E1 0/3 raw AND netted).** ⇒ **Filed as a BUILD REQUIREMENT for C2W8/C2W10 (owner: engineer), never as a C2W6 defect.**
>
> ⭐ **AND A DESIGN RULE FOR ANY FUTURE EROSION GATE (the transferable half):** ⛔ **a step-200 denominator is CONFIG-COUPLED to the trough.** Any future gate must fix its reference reading **OUTSIDE** the transient — e.g. `final ÷ max over the run`, or a registered late-window baseline. ⚠ **And `p1_on` shows the same shape** (min/untrained geo **0.105**, troughs at steps 150 / 725 / 375): ⛔ **P1 does NOT prevent the transient**, which is consistent with the finding that the surviving depth loss is not carried by the partitioned channel alone. ⇒ **the in-flight monitor's trigger should key on the TRANSIENT, not on a monotone trend** — and note this *strengthens* the §A23.1 suspension of the abort criterion (item 3 above): the measured 112× trough that recovers is exactly the false positive the rule was suspended over.
>

### N224 — ⚠ (instrument) The effective-`s` estimator must subtract the confinement term — 1.44× inflation, and every `d/s` in the program rides on it  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✦) · memory-architecture (instrument)

- **Tried:** building the cat test's day-one blocking effective-`s` estimator and comparing it, on the same store family, **with and without** subtracting the confinement contribution `α‖q‖²` (`orgdiv-cat-test` reconciliation 3; handover §7.28).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** **0.438** without subtracting `α‖q‖²` · **0.304** with · ratio **1.44×**. The cat test's own operating point used **`s = 0.318`** (confinement-subtracted), giving the measured `d/s = 2.70` its meaning.
- **Why it matters (mechanism):** the confinement bowl contributes curvature that is **not** the well's — an estimator that fits total curvature reads a well as **wider/deeper than it is**, and the error is multiplicative and systematic, not noise.
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔⛔ **`bprime-c6`'s `s = 0.40` is FLAGGED FOR A CHECK, NOT REFUTED.** Nobody has re-measured that rig with the corrected estimator; whether `CluSystem._well_fit` / the ∇V-ratio law subtract the confinement is an **open question with a named owner requirement**, not a finding. ⚠ **`s` is already known not to be a constant of the architecture (0.482 → 0.362, N180/N181)** — this is a second, independent way for the ruler to move.
- **Disposition:** ⚠ **Charter §A20.5 assigns it: the estimator must subtract `α‖q‖²`.** ⛔ **Until the check is run, every `d/s` statement names its ruler AND its subtraction convention** — the C2W4-era `d/s ≈ 4.3` and the tier-ii band `d/s ∈ [2.5, 2.9]` are quoted in units that have not been shown to be the same unit. ⭐ **Direction, stated because it decides how alarming this is: subtracting the confinement makes `s` SMALLER, hence `d/s` LARGER** — i.e. the uncorrected reading was the *optimistic* one for anything that wanted a small `d/s`.
- **⭐ Dated C2W6 note (2026-08-05, `doc-curator-c2w6-fold`; nothing above rewritten):** the same *estimator-choice* failure mode recurs this wave on a different quantity — **depth aggregates over decades summarised by an arithmetic mean** (§A23.4's censoring erratum; the N223 addendum below; N225's scope block). ⚠ **Two independent rulers moved in two waves for the same reason; the standing practice is now written on both.**

### N225 — ⭐⭐ Erosion is a SYMPTOM OF USELESSNESS, not an intrinsic property of a differentiably-unrolled write  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧) · memory-architecture (tier iii)

- **Tried:** the §A20.6 *"is erosion intrinsic or a symptom?"* 2×2 corner, run as a **labelled DIAGNOSTIC rider** to C2W6's claim cells: the same partition-OFF arm with the **ψ payload residual ON** (the run-2 config, the store useful to the loss) and **OFF** (the store useless to the loss), 1000 outer steps × 3 paired seeds, depth sampled every 25 steps (`c2w6-anti-erosion` §3/§5.1; Advisor re-derivation §A22).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** final/untrained depth **0.141 ± 0.095×** (residual OFF; per-seed **0.019 / 0.075 / 0.329**; geometric mean **0.077×**) against **0.708 ± 0.57×** (residual ON; per-seed **0.135 / 1.847 / 0.140**; geometric mean **0.327×**) — a **5.0×** lower retention. **Destructive-rewrite rate: 0.512 ± 0.238** (residual OFF; per-seed 0.912 / 0.535 / 0.090) · **0.228 ± 0.182** (run-2, per-seed 0.593 / 0.050 / 0.043) · **0.009 ± 0.009** (P1 ON, per-seed 0.027 / 0 / 0). Advisor's per-seed form: OFF `[0.593, 0.050, 0.043]` → ON `[0.027, 0.0, 0.0]`; residual-OFF `[0.912, 0.535, 0.090]`. At seed 0 the residual-OFF store is measurably inert (`live − blank = +1.7e-06`, the pilot's float32 signature).
- **Why it lands (mechanism):** the outer loss only pays for a store it can read. **Strip the one channel that makes the store useful (the ψ payload residual) and the optimizer stops maintaining the wells** — retention and rewrite quality degrade together. ⇒ **erosion is not a property of unrolling the write differentiably; it is what an optimizer does to a component that costs more than it returns.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔⛔ **DIAGNOSTIC label travels: this is the labelled 2×2 corner, NEVER a claim cell.** ⛔ **TOY (0.16 M), 3 paired seeds, w4 ⇒ formally NON-PROMOTABLE under N94 / monitor #13.** ⛔⛔ **Any depth aggregate here must state linear AND geometric** (the arithmetic/geometric split is 0.708 vs 0.327 on the reference arm — §A23 estimator hygiene, adopted as **reporting practice only**). ⛔ **These estimator corrections are POST-HOC with respect to C2W6's registered cells and may NEVER be applied as a re-scoring of a registered verdict** (§A23 process lesson).
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **This is the §A20.6 question ANSWERED and it re-points the tier-iii programme: protect the store by making it USEFUL, not (only) by severing gradients.** ⚠ **The partner statement is N227's: P1 severs the gradient and buys depth at w40 — the two are complementary, and neither makes the memory a net benefit** (the memory-deleted margin is positive on 6/6 cell-seeds; see N227).

### N226 — ✅ The masked write is C3-LOCAL TO FLOAT32 — a receipt that is now a regression check, with a NOT-clean foreign leg beside it  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧) · memory-architecture (tier iii / instrument)

- **Tried:** the interference audit (`PREREG-AntiErosion-ADDENDUM-1` §A1-4): splitting the fitted depth at a live item's own site into its **own** atom rows and every **foreign** row, over **1530–2060 (w4) / 147–630 (w40) / 1708–1943 (resoff)** events per seed (`c2w6-anti-erosion` §5.3).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** **own leg — 0 violations of the decay law on every cell and every seed** across **5553 + 1355 + 5546 events**; residual against the designed prediction `D_after = D_before · group_scale²` is **≤ 3.3e-07** (float32 ULP). **Foreign leg —** foreign-atom depth at a live item's site RISES on **0.383 ± 0.086** of w4 events (0.541 / 0.243 / 0.365) and **0.571 ± 0.082** at w40 (0.731 / 0.461 / 0.520).
- **Why it matters:** ⭐ **the C3-locality property the byte-floor theorem is the price of (N134/N177) is now measured to float32 exactness inside a streaming block, not merely designed.** ⚠ **And the same audit refutes the engineer's own registered A1-4 foreign-up clause at w4 (1/3 seeds, band ≥0.5 on ≥2/3) while CONFIRMING it at w40 (3/3)** — *neighbours crowd in, and they crowd in more when the write budget sits at N94's floor.*
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **TOY (0.16 M), 3 paired seeds; the w4 rows are N94-demoted, the w40 rows are not.** ⚠ **"0 violations" is a statement about the OWN leg only** — quoting it as "the write does not disturb neighbours" is false by the same table.
- **Disposition:** ✅ **Filed as a REGRESSION CHECK, not a result** — the engineer's own framing (*"this is now a live regression check"*). ⚠ **Any future write-operator change re-runs it.**
- **✅ Dated C2W6 FOLD-2 note (2026-08-06, `doc-curator-c2w6-fold-2`; nothing above rewritten) — the own-leg receipt REPRODUCES independently, and the designed decay law is now verified exactly.** The analyst re-derived this audit from raw: the own-leg residual against `D·group_scale²` is ≤ **3.324e-07** over all readings (**confirming** the ≤3.3e-07 above), and the decay law itself — `group_scale = exp(−leak)` per live slot per chunk tick at `leak = 0.02`, depth ∝ amp² ⇒ per-tick relative drop **1 − exp(−0.04) = 0.039211** — is measured at median **0.039211** (min 0.039210, max 0.039211) over **717** readings across all cells and seeds. ⭐ **The law is exact to float32; the masked write is C3-local as designed.** ⚠ **But the instrument caveat is on the OTHER side of the same audit (A1):** the erosion curve those readings feed is **RAW — not netted of this designed decay — and the exponent DRIFTS** because `last_write_chunk` moves **0→12 within one slot** (6–10 distinct values per slot per run). ⛔ **No verdict moves** (netting is conservative; E1 is 0/3 raw *and* netted). ⇒ **netting per well before any rate/flattening claim is a C2W8/C2W10 BUILD REQUIREMENT (owner: engineer).** **Source:** `c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §4; erratum banner 2 item 4. **See also the N223 supersession block and N231.**

### N228 — ⭐⭐ The write→φ PLACEMENT GRADIENT LEAK: sign-SGD does not sever `d(store)/d(φ)` at the shipped config, and the docstring saying it does is FALSE  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧) · memory-architecture (tier iii / program-wide quotation rule)

- **Tried:** the K1 in-system gradient probe on the full two-layer block at the run-2 config, seed 0, one batch — comparing every leaf's gradient norm with `erosion_partition` OFF and ON (`c2w6-anti-erosion` §2; Advisor §A22; Head ruling §A23.3).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** φ's **layer-0** gradient norm **9.083e-02 (OFF) → 6.593e-02 (ON)** ⇒ **27 % of φ's layer-0 gradient flows through the write's placement path**, and P1 is what closes it. ⚠ **Layer 1's φ gradient RISES 2.768e-02 → 4.350e-02** — *the layers are not independent once layer 0's write path is cut.* The forward is unchanged (loss bit-identical), so this is a backward-only intervention.
- **Why it happens (mechanism, exactly):** `write_sign=True`'s docstring argues that `jnp.sign`'s zero derivative severs `d(store state)/d(phi)`, making the trajectory read the only channel to φ *"by construction as well as by theorem"*. **That is true of the INNER-LOOP path only.** ⛔ **H1b's localized placement re-opens it:** `centers[:, :addr] = z[:addr] + jig` is a plain **differentiable** assignment of φ's output into the store's state, **outside the sign-gated loop** — live whenever **`atom_place_radius > 0`**, which is the **run-1/2/3 config** (`atom_place_radius = 0.3`).
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **TOY (0.16 M), seed 0, one batch, layer-0 figure** — the 27 % is a single-cell gradient-norm ratio, not a multi-seed statistic. ⛔ **It says nothing about whether the leak HELPS or HARMS**; it says the channel exists where the program's documents said it could not.
- **Disposition (⭐⭐ PROGRAM-WIDE, §A23.3):** **every *"the write cannot train φ"* statement now needs the placement qualifier:** *"— severed by sign-SGD only when `atom_place_radius = 0`; in the shipped run-1/2/3 config the localized-placement path carries 27 % of φ's layer-0 gradient, closed by `erosion_partition`."* ⚠ **This includes T3-adjacent contexts where the φ-channel claim rides along with *"settled-point γ/M gradients are 0.0 bitwise"* (N201/N152/N135) — those bitwise-zero statements are about the SETTLED-POINT READ and are untouched; only the φ-channel rider needs the qualifier.** ✅ **Owner assigned: the engineer corrects `write_sign`'s docstring** (`c2w6-phi-leak-docstring`) **and the curator files this entry + the qualifier.** ⚠ **The per-site sweep is `BLOCKED-PENDING` as of this fold — the engineer's grep list did not exist at fold time; see `doc-curator-c2w6-fold` §5.**

### N229 — ⛔ I2 = `NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE` — accepted as an UNDERPOWERED reading, never a clean null; the depth-as-feature-importance caveat stays ACTIVE  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧) · memory-architecture (tier iii / quotation caveat)

- **Tried:** the registered usage-vs-erosion telemetry — per well, per monitor window: fitted depth · last-write chunk · read-selection proxy · `‖∂L_outer/∂(this well's atom rows)‖` · leave-one-well-out probe bpc at 4 checkpoints — scored as Spearman **ρ(well usefulness, erosion rate)** on the partition-OFF arm. **Registered direction (the Head's hypothesis): ρ ≥ +0.5** (most-useful wells erode fastest); **refutation branch ρ ≤ −0.3** (the optimizer prunes USELESS wells — the only branch that could have LIFTED the caveat); **|ρ| < 0.3 = no usage structure** (`c2w6-anti-erosion` §6).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** primary arm `p1_off` (w4) — **ρ(read-selection) = −0.2571 ± 0.1512** (per-seed +0.029 / −0.486 / −0.314; pooled **−0.323** over 18 wells) and **ρ(LOO Δbpc) = +0.0667 ± 0.1627**. `w40_p1_off`: +0.081 ± 0.475 (per-seed **+0.872 / +0.143 / −0.771**). `resoff_p1_off` ⛔DIAG: −0.048 ± 0.135. Third column ρ(‖∂L/∂atoms‖, erosion) pooled **+0.220 (w4) / +0.108 (w40) / +0.176 (resoff)**. ⭐ **The partition's in-flight receipt: on every P1-ON arm this column is `nan` because `‖∂L/∂(atom rows)‖ ≡ 0` for every well at every one of the 41 readings** — K1 holding continuously through training, not just at init.
- **Why it is not a clean null (and this is the whole entry):** ⛔ **the two proxies DISAGREE IN SIGN** on the primary arm; per-seed ρ at w40 spans **+0.872 to −0.771**; and **`n_wells = 5–6` per seed** makes every ρ a 6-point rank correlation. **The engineer's own honest read: *"not confirmed and not refuted — unmeasurable at 6 wells/seed."*** ⚠ **The analyst who would have adjudicated ρ from raw returned `BLOCKED` (its gate had not landed) and never scored it.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔⛔ **NEVER quote any I2 ρ as a measured null** — it is an underpowered reading. ⛔ **The registered branch string is `NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE`; that is a branch label, not a finding about the store.**
- **Disposition (Head ruling §A23.5):** ✅ **`NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE` ACCEPTED; re-measurement DEFERRED to C2W10** (the persistent-store wave, where live-well counts can support it). ⛔ **No rig change is funded now.** ⛔⛔ **RE-AFFIRMED AS ACTIVE: depth is NOT quotable as feature importance (charter §A21/§A23.5)** — only the refutation branch could have lifted it, and I2 returned no-structure. ⚠ **The rig change the measurement would need is registered in `future_work.md`: more live items (capacity/budget up, or longer sequences) or pooling across lanes — both change the rig and must be registered first.**

> - ⛔ **WHAT THE RIG *CANNOT* DO: separate ρ_true = 0 from |ρ_true| ≤ 0.4.** The observed −0.2571 lies **inside** the 95 % compatibility range for **true ρ ∈ [0, 0.4]** and **outside** it for **ρ ≥ 0.5** (null 95 % interval at true ρ = 0 is **[−0.505, +0.505]**).
> - ⇒ ⭐ **The precise form: `NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE` is the correct registered branch AND a HALF-INFORMATIVE reading — not a clean null, and not simply "unmeasurable."** ⛔ **The engineer's closing line *"not confirmed and not refuted — it is unmeasurable at 6 wells/seed"* is TOO PESSIMISTIC on the primary proxy and TOO GENEROUS on the LOO proxy** (which is genuinely unmeasurable, ρ ceiling 0). ⚠ **Supporting statistics:** stratified exact permutation test (within-seed relabelling, primary proxy, p1_off) — observed mean ρ **−0.2571**, null sd **0.2580**, two-sided **p = 0.349**; the analyst's pre-registered floor-censoring rule was **NOT triggered** (0/705 live-well readings below 1e-30; min live depth 2.506e-04), so all 3 seeds are scored.
>
> **4. ⚠ A3 — RELABEL: the engineer's §6 "pooled (n wells)" ρ column is a NON-REGISTERED estimator and it FLIPS SIGN.** On the mechanism row, pooled **+0.2198** vs the registered per-seed-then-mean **−0.1619 ± 0.2806**. ⛔ **The sentence *"the gradient magnitude … is weakly predictive … the mechanism the hypothesis assumed"* DOES NOT SURVIVE the registered estimator — read it as relabelled, not as evidence.** ⚠ **This entry's own Numbers block quotes that pooled column (*"pooled +0.220 (w4) / +0.108 (w40) / +0.176 (resoff)"*, and `pooled −0.323` over 18 wells on the primary row): ⛔ those are NON-REGISTERED figures and must not be quoted as the estimator.** ✅ **The registered estimator is Spearman per seed over live wells, then mean ± SE across seeds.**

### N230 — ⚠ (process, self-caught by pre-registration) An untrained count is not a rig property — the engineer's own A1-3 is REFUTED by its own cells  · tier C (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧) · all (process)

- **Tried:** `PREREG-AntiErosion-ADDENDUM-1` §A1-3, registered by the engineer **before** the science cells, predicting **"0 rewrite events, structurally"** — derived from an *untrained* count (13/19/16 admits, 0 slot reuse, 3 seeds) plus the arithmetic `n_chunks = 16 ≤ capacity = 8` (`c2w6-anti-erosion` §5.1/§7).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** after training, rewrite events occur: **27 / 40 / 70 per run** (`p1_off`), violation rate **0.593 / 0.050 / 0.043**, mean **0.228 ± 0.182**. ⭐ **The parent prereg's I1-a is CONFIRMED by the same numbers** (inside the registered 10–40 % point band and the 2–60 % band), and **I1-b is CONFIRMED post-guard: 0 / 0 / 0 violations over 165 rewrite events**, guard fired 6× at seed 0. ⚠ **The engineer self-corrected its own I1-b table pre/post-guard** (the write's `violation` flag is the PRE-guard verdict; `post_guard_violations()` recomputes the registered statistic — commit `d8c9fa7`), and both counts are reported everywhere.
- **Why it failed (mechanism):** **φ's drift changes the allocator's slot choices**, so clean rewrites appear after training that are structurally impossible at init. ⇒ ***an untrained count is not a rig property.***
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **A1-3 is quoted nowhere downstream and must never be** (Head-adopted never-quote). ⚠ **At w40 the rewrite channel is silent (64 events, 0 violations) — I1's value is a w4-budget artifact at this rig**, which is why `refresh_monotonic` ships **False**.
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **Filed as an exemplar, not a demerit:** the engineer registered a prediction, its own cells refuted it, and it reported the refutation in its first ten lines. ⚠ **Second instance of the same family this wave — the analyst's own PREREG registered `|ρ| < 0.3` AGAINST the Head's registered direction and was never scorable** (N229). **Precedent: N55, N43, N44.**
- **⭐ Dated C2W6 FOLD-2 correction (2026-08-06, `doc-curator-c2w6-fold-2`; nothing above rewritten) — the analyst's prereg WAS scored, and it WAS partially refuted, and the analyst reported it as a finding.** The line above (*"…and was never scorable"*) was written from the analyst's `BLOCKED` report; on the re-spawn it **scored its own prediction and self-refuted it.** ⛔ **Registered: *"|ρ| < 0.3 (no-structure) on 2/3 seeds."* Measured: 1/3** (+0.029 ✓, −0.486 ✗, −0.314 ✗); **netted also 1/3.** ⭐ **The *aggregate* form of the prediction lands in the band; the *per-seed* form does not.** ⭐⭐ **And the analyst diagnosed its own error in the same terms it had used to flag the engineer's: *"the per-seed commitment was the wrong one at n = 6, where the exact null sd of a single-seed ρ is 0.447 — my own prereg made the same n-blind error I flagged in F2."*** ⚠ **It also recorded that its mechanistic derivation (erosion carried by shared φ, not per-well credit) is *consistent* with the result but NOT evidenced by it — the mechanism row (ρ_grad −0.1619 ± 0.2806) is itself a null.** ⇒ ⭐⭐ **This is therefore a SECOND n-blind estimator error caught in two waves, by two different agents, each on its own prereg — and both reported as findings rather than buried.** ✅ **The process line worth keeping: a pre-registered prediction that survives is evidence; one that fails is a FINDING; an un-pre-registered agreement is neither** (protocol §5). **Source:** `c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §5 (closing paragraph); the `[C2W6-ADJUDICATED]` §10 entry.

### N231 — ⛔⛔ (instrument) The I2 rig cannot answer I2, for THREE separable reasons — and one of them is that the registered rule CAPS ITS OWN CONFIRMATION PROBABILITY AT ANY n  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✧✧✧, ⚠ **CURATOR-INITIATED — flagged for Hub ratification**) · memory-architecture (tier iii / instrument · methodology)

- **Tried:** pricing the `NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE` verdict rather than accepting it — measuring the I2 instrument's **reliability**, its **construct validity**, and the **operating characteristics of the registered decision rule itself** (`c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §6, simulation `power_pricing.py`, 200 k draws/row, Gaussian copula, seed 20260805). ⛔ **Declared POST-HOC in the source and labelled as such; it changes NO verdict.**
- **Numbers (verbatim), the three failures:**
  **(a) THE PROXY — reliability ≤ 0.** Leave-one-well-out `Δbpc`, ICC(1,1) over 4 checkpoints: **−0.205 / −0.218 / −0.248 (3/3 seeds)** ⇒ **attenuation ceiling 0.000.** (By contrast the usable ones: read-selection split-half Spearman-Brown **0.648** (ρ½ 0.486/0.725/0.290); erosion rate odd-vs-even **0.633** (ρ½ 0.771/0.086/0.771).)
  **(b) THE CONSTRUCT — the two registered usefulness measures are ANTI-correlated:** ρ(read-selection, LOO) = **−0.257 / −0.600 / −0.657 → −0.505 ± 0.125, 4.04 SE, 3/3.** And **8/18 wells are net-harmful** (only 10/18 have `loo_delta_bpc > 0`).
  **(c) ⭐⭐ THE RULE — self-capping.** P(confirm | **true ρ = exactly the registered +0.5**), because the rule thresholds *at* the effect size: **0.424** at 6 wells × 3 seeds (rel 1.0) · **0.282** at 6×3 (rel 0.648) · **0.439** at 20×3 · **0.468** at 100×3 · **0.432** at 100×10 · **0.171** at 6×30. Symmetrically **P(false refute | true ρ = 0) = 0.123** at the current 6×3.
  **(d) ⚠ AND A FOURTH, IDENTITY-LEVEL PROBLEM: slot ≠ well.** Same-slot site displacement between consecutive readings is **0.443 / 1.525 / 0.533** (p1_off s0/s1/s2) against a between-slot spread of **1.084 / 2.278 / 1.668** ⇒ ratios **0.41 / 0.67 / 0.32** at `atom_place_radius = 0.30`. **A slot's occupant changes materially over a run, so both "the well's erosion rate" and "the well's usefulness" are SLOT-LEVEL MIXTURES.**
- **Why it lands (mechanism):** ⭐⭐ **a decision rule that thresholds the estimator *at* the hypothesised effect size can never confirm that effect more than ~50 % of the time, at ANY sample size** — the sampling distribution of the estimator is centred on the threshold. ⇒ ⛔⛔ ***BUYING WELLS AGAINST THE CURRENT RULE IS MONEY FOR NOTHING* (P(confirm) moves 0.424 → 0.468 going from 6 to 100 wells).** The rule, not the n, is the binding constraint.
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **POST-HOC and simulation-based; it PRICES a registered verdict and NEVER re-scores one** — `NO_USAGE_STRUCTURE` stands as the registered branch. ⛔ **TOY (0.16 M), 3 seeds, 5–6 live wells/seed.** ⚠ **This is an instrument/methodology negative, not a result about the store.** ⛔ **It does NOT license lifting the depth-as-feature-importance caveat** (N229) — if anything it is a second reason to keep it up.
- **Disposition — ⭐⭐ THREE THINGS MUST BE RE-REGISTERED, IN THIS ORDER, BEFORE I2 IS RE-RUN AT ANY SCALE (a binding input to C2W10's scoping, §A23.5):** **(i)** ⭐ **replace *"confirm iff mean ρ ≥ +0.5"* with a TEST AGAINST 0** (Fisher-z CI, two-sided 5 %) — **it is free and it is the binding constraint**; under a test-against-0 at true ρ_s = 0.5 with 80 % power you need `seeds × (n_wells − 3) ≥ 26` at perfect reliability (**3 seeds × 12 wells, or 6 wells × 9 seeds**) and **≥ 43** at the measured rel 0.648 (**3 seeds × 17 wells, or 6 wells × 14 seeds**); **(ii)** ⭐ **an ITEM-ID KEY in the per-well telemetry** — *a prerequisite, not an upgrade*; **(iii)** ⭐ **a LOO probe with enough batches/checkpoints to have POSITIVE ICC, or drop it and register a single primary proxy.** ⛔ **Only THEN is raising `capacity`/`budget` or pooling lanes to n_wells ≥ 17/seed worth the compute.** ⚠ **Related build requirement from the same report (A1, owner: engineer): net the designed decay per well before any erosion-rate/flattening claim** (see the N226 fold-2 note and the N223 supersession block). ⚠ **The analyst's own scoping note: the `w40` cell is where the science is and it is the LEAST powered** (n = 5–6 wells, 17 readings, per-seed ρ spanning +0.872 … −0.771, and the only cell where erosion appears at all) — **C2W8 should put its instrument budget there, not at w4.**
- **Source:** `c2w6-erosion-adjudication` §6(a)–(e) + §"Open questions" 1–3; the `[C2W6-ADJUDICATED]` §10 entry (*"the registered I2 rule is SELF-CAPPING and more data does not fix it … this is a binding input to C2W10's scoping"*). **See also N229 / N226 / N223 supersession block.**

### N238 — ⚠ (instrument) Least squares against a thresholded metric is unstable in BOTH directions  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✪) · memory-architecture (instrument)

- **Tried:** measuring the two named suspects — `diag(W)` shrinkage and the `tol` crossing — on **every** re-scored cell rather than assuming them (`null_arms.shrinkage_report`; `reader-fitting-audit` §6/§6.1, PREREG P13a).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** shrinkage on 7 of 8 fitted/identity pairs, `diag(W)` mean **+0.128 … +0.446** (in the pre-registered [0.05, 0.70] band); ⛔ **one outlier in the opposite direction — `sum_linear` at the `orgdiv-cat-test` cell INFLATES to `diag(W) = +46.53`, driving its mean residual to 13.48 against the identity reader's 1.84.**
- **Why it happens (mechanism):** least squares minimises a **continuous** residual while the metric is an **all-or-nothing threshold at `tol`**. When the latent's payload block is far off the family's scale the fit absorbs the scale factor — upward here, downward everywhere else — and in **both** regimes the residual it minimises is not the quantity being scored.
- **Scope / limits:** changes **no verdict** (both readers are ≈ 0 at `tol` on that cell). ⚠ **The engineer flags this may be a STORE fact rather than a reader fact** — the settled payload block sits at ~**1/46** of the family's scale, possibly the same basin-reach issue `tierii-read-fix` D10 measured. ⛔ **Owner needed on the physics arm; the curator does not resolve it.**
- **Disposition:** ⛔⛔ **STANDING: a fitted reader's RESIDUAL is never evidence that a store is "close" to the answer.** ⚠ **Filed as the companion to N237's Known-Issue entry — the artifact is two-directional, and only the shrinkage direction has a bound (K6).**

### N253 — ⭐⭐ C3 locality HOLDS in parameter space and FAILS in function space — atoms have tails  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✬) · memory-architecture (write-side design input)

- **Tried:** splitting the fitted depth at each live item's own site into **own-atom vs foreign-atom** contributions, and auditing every write with **C2W6's residual instrument imported unchanged** (`exp_anti_erosion._interference_audit`; that file **not edited**), 105 events per seed (`c2w8-well-lifecycle` §3.3; ERRATA §5).

- **Why it matters (mechanism):** ⭐⭐ **a write touches only its own atom block — and atoms have TAILS.** Locality in **parameters** (which parameters the write may modify) is exact to float32; locality in **function** (what the landscape looks like at another item's site) fails on four writes in five. ⇒ ⭐ **"depth at an item's site" is largely NOT that item's own well**, which is why depth RISES over the stream (0.74 → 1.66) while retrieval FALLS (N252). ⭐ **Pass 2 applies exactly this lesson one level down** — the C2W8 K2 build already learned it for `γ_φ` (a **compact** gate, because *a sigmoid tail makes a "local" change global*, N261).
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **3 seeds, one rig, 105 events/seed, TOY, non-promotable.** ⚠⚠ **`own/foreign` is a DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A TARGET and never a gate leg (binding in all three pass-2 task files): under PRIVATE wells a high foreign contribution is interference, but in a FACTORED store it is the SIGNAL (compositionality)** — over-fitting to own-dominance now buys a reversal later. ⭐ **The invariant that survives both designs is RETRIEVABILITY.**
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **Filed as the wave's diagnosis and as a write-side design input**, beside N244/N233 (attractors not at their designed anchors) — the same family of failure measured on a second rig. ⛔ **Any future "depth" reading on this rig must state own-vs-foreign**, and any depth/erosion curve must be reported **RAW and NETTED** (C2W6's A1, discharged into this wave as build requirement B1 and delivered).

### N256 — ⭐⭐ In a strong feature space the damped settle *IS* nearest-key indexing — the residual deficit is the buffer's ADMISSION POLICY, not the read  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✬) · memory-architecture / positioning (doctrine flagship)

- **Tried:** decomposing the laundering deficit by scoring the CLU settle against **its own same keys** (a kNN over exactly the store's keys, the settle deleted — nothing else differs) as well as against the **class-balanced ring buffer**, at every φ arm, in the same φ object (`c2w8-cifar-strong-phi` §2/§5).
- **Numbers (verbatim):** CLU **minus its own same-keys kNN** — `randconv` **+0.0003 ± 0.0003** · `convae` **−0.0007 ± 0.0007** · ⭐ **`simclr` +0.0002 ± 0.0004** (seed 0: CLU **0.3256** vs same-keys **0.3252** = **+0.0004**) — ⛔ **against `pca` −0.0480 ± 0.0050.** CLU **minus the ring buffer** — `randconv` −0.0224 ± 0.0081 · `convae` −0.0104 ± 0.0070 · `simclr` **−0.0142 ± 0.0035** · `pca` −0.0653 ± 0.0085. ⭐ **The deficit shrinks monotonically as φ strengthens: −0.068 → −0.024 → −0.012 / −0.014**, and the residual is stable at ≈ **−0.014** with a tight SE. **Geometry at end of stream (200 live wells), all four arms:** median-NN 9.551 / 0.852 / 1.005 / 0.975, `s` 1.886 / 0.170 / 0.198 / 0.192, `σ_q` 9.038 / 0.830 / 0.979 / 0.946 ⇒ **corrected packing slack 0.341 / 0.331 / 0.331 / 0.332** — identical to w25's CIFAR 0.337–0.345, MNIST ≈ 0.33 and `cl-encoder`'s 0.332.
- **Why (mechanism):** ⭐⭐ **in a good address space the store's read adds exactly nothing over `argmin‖φ(q) − key‖`** — a tie to four decimals on all three strong arms — **and the remaining 0.014 is bought by a class-balanced ADMISSION policy any ring buffer can run.** ⭐ **The geometric reason it cannot be otherwise here: `σ_q ≈ median-NN` (a test query is about as far from its nearest address as two addresses are from each other), so with basins that crowded the settle can only land in the nearest well** — ⛔ **P8 confirmed a second time, now with the CLU settle actually run: a better φ does NOT de-crowd the store, because crowding is intrinsic to a CLASSIFICATION stream.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **Split-CIFAR-10 reduced protocol, Class-IL, `task1_only`, 200 items, designed `AtomStorePotential` + MVC-0 controller with `newtonian_identity`, `clu_steps = 150`, zero gradient steps in the store.** ⚠ **Most of w25's CIFAR laundering gap was φ's weakness, not the store's — that half is a REAL correction and travels with the rest.** ⛔ **The deficit does not cross, and this is the registered N8 prediction (prior 0.15) holding.**
- ⭐⭐ **DATED FOLLOW-ON (2026-08-10, C2W8 PASS-3 + CLOSE fold; body above untouched) — REPRODUCED AT A THIRD SUBSTRATE, ON THE CENSUS RIG, AS A PRE-REGISTERED BRANCH.** The ±0.0007-class result measured here is now measured **on the store-with-physics census rig at strong φ**: **branch (b) NO DAYLIGHT, 0/9 cells, 3/3 arms**, computed by the registered `daylight_verdict` rule (Hub prior **Q6 = 0.70**, nothing tuned), with **|A3b| ≤ 0.047 on 7 of 9 cells** and 8/9 inside 2 SE ⇒ ⭐⭐ **the store and an 832-byte table are statistically indistinguishable on held-out stream reads** (`c2w8p3-capture-strong-phi` §4). ⭐ **And it is ATTRIBUTABLE, not confounded:** the store is **NOT inert at `d = 12`** (9/9 cells, depth 0.470–0.965), `geometry_go = true` **verified in advance**, `gate_addr_validated = true` **verified in advance**. ⇒ **tier-i protocol evidence at a THIRD substrate** (gym → LM block → CL census), **flagged to the B′/shorts track** — ⛔ **the curator MARKS the row; the B′ revision is the writer track's and is Head-sequenced.** ⚠ **This entry's own "settle = nearest-key indexing" mechanism is NOT thereby explained:** the pass-3 cells have **comfortable** geometry and **real basins** and the settle **still** extracts less from the cue than 1-NN over the same keys — that is the **registered OPEN mechanism question** (§A31.2, **N275**), ⛔ **theorist-priced, not assumed.** ⛔ **Does NOT falsify anything: losing to a kNN launder on a metric-native cue protocol is the metric-native-ceiling theorem** (1-NN is the Bayes rule there), which is exactly why **§A32.1 PROHIBITS a pass 4 chasing daylight here.** (**N276**.)
- **Disposition:** ⭐⭐ **The sharpest statement of the laundering result the program holds, and it converts the launder from a mystery into a NAMED, CHEAP mechanism question: why does the MVC-0 controller's own class-balanced eviction rule under-perform a plain balanced ring buffer by 0.014?** ⭐ **That is the only visible route to crossing N8 on this benchmark, and it is contained** (⛔ **not more φ compute**). ⭐ **Sixth consecutive laundering confirmation** (N89 / CM-22(i) lineage; the required wording travels: *the win is φ's and the buffer's, not the store's*). ⛔ **Nothing here is a store result; the store's own contribution measured against its trivial substitute is 0.000 ± 0.0004.**

### N258 — ⭐ Rider 3b: *"reconstruction bought nothing"* is a READ-OUT artifact, and `cl-encoder` §3's arm-isolation table is not safe to quote  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✬) · memory-architecture (banked-table correction)

- **Tried:** `cl-encoder` §3 isolated the φ arms *"at the best read-out"* on seed 0 and decomposed what bought the gate movement (architecture vs reconstruction vs contrastive vs compute); C2W8 then ran all four arms end-to-end at the **measured** read-out with the CLU settle actually run (`cl-encoder` §3/§4; `c2w8-cifar-strong-phi` reconciliation 3 / §1 / §2 / §6).
- **Numbers (verbatim).** **Banked (`cl-encoder` §3, seed 0, pre-sweep read-out defaults):** PCA-32 0.209 → `randconv` **0.244 (+0.035)** → `convae` **0.238 (−0.006, "bought nothing")** → `simclr` 2 k 0.285 (+0.041) → 8 k 0.350 (+0.065). ⛔ **That read-out corner is measured in `cl-encoder`'s OWN §4 as the worst of 28 configs: whitened PCA · no L2 · `d = 256` = 0.2676, against the chosen `keep` spatial · plain PCA · L2 · `d = 256` = 0.3496.** **Measured at the chosen read-out (`c2w8-cifar-strong-phi`, 3 seeds):** `convae` **CLU 0.267 ± 0.006**, **kNN-ring 0.277 ± 0.003**, against `randconv` **0.213 ± 0.006** / 0.235 ± 0.005 ⇒ ⭐ **+0.054 over `randconv`**, and `convae` **clears N7 at +0.1063 ± 0.0038 paired (3/3 seeds)** — ⛔ **falsifying that report's own pre-registered `convae` MISS** (registered CLU band 0.18–0.25; measured 0.267).
- **Why the banked reading is wrong (mechanism):** ⭐ **the `h → φ` read-out is not free, and the pre-sweep default was its worst corner** — whitening amplifies low-variance trunk directions that a 1-NN read-out then treats as signal (−0.028 mean, up to **−0.075** at `d = 256`), and dropping the 2×2 spatial map costs **−0.023**. **An arm comparison run at that corner measures the corner, not the objective.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⚠ **Two cells, both TOY reduced-protocol CIFAR; `convae` is 3 seeds.** ⛔ **The read-out was selected on the decision metric on seed 0 of the `simclr` trunk and applied unchanged to all arms** — which makes `convae`'s hit *conservative* (it is obtained under a read-out tuned on a different objective) **and it must be said.** ⚠ **Nothing else in `cl-encoder` moves:** §2's gate values, §4's sweep, §5's strict-φ cost **+0.020 ± 0.010** (declared NOT-RUN here, **unamended**) and §7's geometry all stand.
- **Disposition:** ⛔⛔ **NEVER-QUOTE ~~*"the reconstruction objective bought nothing (−0.006)"*~~ and ~~*"`convae` never beat the untrained trunk"*~~, and ⛔ **`cl-encoder` §3's objective/architecture decomposition may not be quoted at all.** ⛔ **The correction is NOT *"reconstruction helps"*.** ✅ **The only approved form: *the SIGN of the objective comparison depends on the read-out, and the banked table's read-out was not the measured one.*** ⭐ **A defensible "the objective matters" sentence requires re-running §3's isolation table at the measured read-out — it does not exist** (`future_work.md`). **Filed as:** a **dated curator amendment banner on `.claude/outputs/cl-encoder.md`** (body untouched, C-3 precedent) · a **dated amendment block on N121** · a **dated update on `HEP_primers.md` §11.9's wave-26 block**, which carried the forbidden wording verbatim.

### N259 — ⚠ (engineering) `cl_baselines.ConvNet` cannot run under `jax_enable_x64` — and two x64-ordering bugs shipped "green" on file-level runs  · tier C (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✬) · all (silent-hazard / ordering family)

Fixed at `4875002` with **one function-scoped regression test** (⛔ **module-scoped x64 fixtures are themselves the N211 hazard, so the remedy is deliberately not a fixture**).
- **Why it matters:** ⛔ **the K2 flag would have shipped "green" on a file-level run and reddened the suite for the next agent** — the failure is invisible at the granularity most agents test at. ⚠ **Fourth bill for the still-unbuilt `conftest.py` x64 guard** (N72 / N211 / N249 family).
- **Scope / limits:** ⚠ **Engineering/harness, not science; no reported number is affected.** Measured on this machine (macOS, main venv, JAX 0.9.0).
- **Disposition:** ⚠ **`cl_baselines.py` needs an OWNER — it is outside both spokes' ownership and the fix is one line.** ⭐ **Standing practice reinforced: an x64-sensitive change is verified by the FULL suite, never by a file-level run.**

- ✅ **DATED RESOLUTION (2026-08-09, C2W8 PASS-2 fold; body above untouched) — THE `ConvNet` HALF IS CLOSED; ONE DOC-DRIFT ITEM SURVIVES AND STILL HAS NO OWNER.** `c2w8p2-instruments-and-debt` (wt3) **reproduced the bug first** (`weight dtype float64` vs float32 image ⇒ `TypeError: lax.conv_general_dilated requires arguments to have the same dtypes`), diagnosed the cause exactly — **conv weights built at the AMBIENT JAX dtype while `build_cl_stream` always supplies float32, and `lax.conv_general_dilated` is dtype-STRICT; several test modules set `jax_enable_x64` at module import, so x64 is globally ON in a full-suite run and the whole `backbone="cnn"` path was untestable inside the suite (§7.23 / N211 hazard class, 4th occurrence)** — and **RESOLVED it at `42b781c`** with a **one-line** fix (promote the input to the **parameter** dtype: `jnp.asarray(x, dtype=self.conv[0].weight.dtype)`; **at x64-off this is float32→float32, a no-op**; no parameter, shape or default changed; `MLPNet` untouched). **Coverage shipped, `tests/test_cl_baselines_x64.py`, 5 tests:** CNN forward under x64 on float32 images · `make_net(backbone="cnn")` + one `_train_task` step under x64 (forward + `filter_value_and_grad` + adam; wt3 did not edit it (it is the pass-1 CIFAR spoke's file). ⚠ **And the standing rule wt3 filed: any dtype-strict JAX primitive must be fed at the PARAMETER dtype — modules must never assume the ambient dtype matches their data.** ⚠ **The `conftest.py` x64 guard is still unbuilt (the bill stands).**

- **Disposition:** ⭐ **Filed as a positive with its scope clause because the scope is what will be dropped in quotation:** ✅ *"a C1 artifact is finally live, OFF, bit-identical and parameter-count-identical, with real designed negatives"* — ⛔ **never *"the trash region works"*.** ⭐⭐ **The compact-gate lesson is now doctrine and is load-bearing beyond this build: a sigmoid tail makes a "local" change global** — the same statement N253 measures for **atoms** (local in parameters ≠ local in the landscape), and the explicit design hint C2W8 pass 2 was scoped on.

- **Tried:** arm A bundles **two** levers (a compact `wendland` kernel · `atom_site_local_init`). Both ablations were registered **with predictions** in `ERRATA-C2W8-PASS2.md` §3 **before they ran** (pilot seed 7), and AB1 was then promoted to **census strength** (§4, also registered first) **because it falsified the engineer's own prediction**.

- **Why (mechanism):** what closes the gate is **bounded reach = the co-scaled width + the site-local init** — both of which bound reach — **not the exactly-zero support**. At this operating point compactness is **not necessary** and **costs a little `decode`**, plausibly because a force that is exactly zero outside `R` also removes the pull on a read launched off its well (the same mechanism as the payload-launch wall: with a compact atom the force at the census's launch point — payload channel at 0 while the well sits at `a_i ∈ [−0.5, +0.5]` — is **exactly zero whenever `|a_i| > R`**, so **G-CAP can pass while G-DRIFT fails for a reason that has nothing to do with the well and everything to do with the launch manifold**; the bimodality disappears exactly where `R` crosses `max|a_i| = 0.5`, 10 bare-bowl wells → 0).

### N270 — ⛔ A reach hinge cannot supply a write→`φ` organization gradient — and the first configuration that tried produced a DEGENERATE cell  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✭) · memory-architecture (write-side design rule)

- **Tried:** building the **designed** write→`φ` organization gradient charter §A28.1 registers, inside an amortised head, **without** violating the anti-pin prohibition — first with a **reach hinge** alone (`relu(‖q_launch − z‖ − ρ·s)²`), then with the hinge plus a **competitive attribution margin** (`relu(m + ‖q_i − z_i‖ − min_{j≠i}‖q_i − z_j‖)²`) and a trainable center skip.
- **Numbers (verbatim, `ERRATA-ARMB.md` §1, filed BEFORE the final run; §7.1):** **config 1 (no skip, no attribution term)** — seed 0 admitted **2 / 16**, `n_live` 2, `overdig` **0.25**, **G-CAP 0.000**, `decode` 0.500 vs launder 0.750, drift **0.339** vs spacing 0.141; seed 1 admitted **1 / 16**, `n_live` 1, `overdig` **0.12**, G-CAP 0.000, decode 1.000 vs 1.000, drift 0.213 vs 0.138 ⇒ **38 of 40 offers refused because the head emitted near-identical centers.** **Final configuration:** the anti-pin properties are pytest-asserted (the hinge is **bitwise 0 with a bitwise-0 gradient in the center** once the launch is inside `ρ·s`, and is satisfiable **by growing `s` at a fixed center** — its zero set is a **manifold**, against a pin's unique minimiser which is *never* 0 and pulls at every step, value 0.16 / gradient > 0.5 at the same point; the attribution margin is **exactly 0 for a single item** — precisely where a pin is most active — and has an **exactly zero gradient** once the margin holds; the skip is an **initialisation** whose only subsequent pressure is decoupled weight decay, i.e. **toward ignoring `φ`**).
- **Why (mechanism — the arm's theoretical result):** ⭐⭐ **at any usable well width the basin (`ρ·s`) is comparable to the WHOLE address ball, so *"the launch must be inside the basin"* is near-vacuous and the head collapses to a CONSTANT placement map. The only way to make that hinge bite is to shrink its slack to the key spacing — at which point it IS a pin.** ⇒ ⭐ **the escape is the COMPETITIVE form (attribution), and that is what §A28.1's designed gradient has to be if it is not to violate the Head's prohibition. It applies to any future placement-emitting write.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **the degenerate cell is NOT arm B's reading** — a gate scored on 1–2 wells is not the pass-2 gate; artifacts retained and labelled (`census_armB_CONFIG1_DEGENERATE.json` / `armB_run_CONFIG1_DEGENERATE.log`). ⚠ **Config selection was scored ONLY on "items are admitted", "centers clear `d_safe`", "centers stay in reach of `φ`" — `capture_radius`, `decode` and `site_drift` were never evaluated during selection**, and the final configuration was run **once per seed with no seed re-run after its result was seen.** ⚠ **`attribution_margin_penalty` is new code with one wave of use and no theory attached.**
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **Register the design rule, not the arm:** *a reach hinge cannot supply a write→`φ` organization gradient; the competitive/attribution form is the only one measured to work.* ⚠ **If it is carried into C2W9/C2W10 it must be RE-REGISTERED with its own kill-condition** (the engineer's own recommendation). ⭐ **Exemplar: the degenerate first configuration was filed in a dated erratum BEFORE the final run and reported in full, not quietly replaced.**

- **Disposition:** ⭐⭐ **STANDING: a per-file `grep` for a CONCEPT must exclude filename/path matches, or a "verified worklist" ships phantom entries.** ⭐ **Filed beside the standing sweep rule it refines: directory-level search over `.claude/` is void (gitignored) ⇒ sweep per file, and positive-control every negative.**

### N293 — ⚠⚠ (environment, program-wide) Worktree and broken-ref cleanup is NOT DURABLE on this machine — a removed ref came back and broke `git merge`  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✮) · all (engineering hazard)

- **Tried:** removing two merged worktrees (`CHLU-p3v2`, `CHLU-c2w8p3c`) and the broken ref **`refs/remotes/clu-dev/main 2`** at the spine merge, and recording *"zero worktrees"* in the wave's close entry.

- **Why it matters:** ⛔⛔ **a left-in-place broken ref makes `git merge` die with `fatal: stash failed` ON A CLEAN TREE** — the failure mode is loud but its cause is invisible (the ref pointed at `1eda6a0`, already an ancestor of `main`, i.e. **nothing unique**). ⚠ **And it falsified a statement that was TRUE when written:** the close entry's *"zero worktrees"* was accurate at the moment of writing and false hours later.

- **Disposition:** ⛔⛔ **STANDING HAZARD: check `git worktree list` and `.git/refs/remotes/clu-dev/` at the START of a session, not only at the end.** ⭐ **And if `git` warns *"ignoring ref with broken name"*, inspect and remove that ref rather than working around it — it will break the next merge.** ⭐ **Reporting rule that follows: a cleanliness claim in a §10 entry is a statement about a MOMENT; re-verify it at the next session rather than inheriting it.**

- **Numbers (verbatim, `c2w10-benchmark-gate` §2/§3/§5 + `BENCHMARK-GATE.json`):** **B1 PASS** — No-Change **40.4526** vs Souza's published **40.46** (Δ **−0.0074**; a pure function of the label sequence, so any re-ordering would move it — it does not); ARF-100 **78.8139 ± 0.0526 SD** (3 seeds) vs published **77.13** (Δ +1.6839). **B2:** best registered exemplar arm **SAM-kNN L_max = 5000 (std) = 76.9157 %** at **665,000 B** ⇒ **`b2_margin_pts = −1.8983`**, **`criterion4_cleared = FALSE`**. ⭐ **It fires against EVERY ARF reference computed:** −1.898 (3-seed mean, the pre-registered one) · −1.937 (best seed) · −1.838 (worst seed) · **−0.4972** (our ARF-10) · **−0.2143** (Souza's published 77.13). Unregistered **stronger** arm **SAM-kNN L_max = 1000 (std) = 77.0632 %** at **133,000 B** — within **0.07 points** of the published state-of-the-art ensemble. **Second condition** (`incremental-abrupt-reoccurring`, bal.): best exemplar **74.3802** vs ARF-100 **76.2251 ± 0.0381** ⇒ **−1.845**, false again. **B3 PASS:** ARF `κ_per` = **0.64422**.
- **Why (mechanism, measured):** ⛔ **exemplar accuracy is MONOTONE DECREASING in store size above L ≈ 500** — kNN_S(std) **75.56 / 76.03 / 75.36 / 73.39 / 68.15 / 59.75** at L = 250 / 500 / 1000 / 2000 / 5000 / **14,782**, so the **CLU-byte-matched** store (14,782 exemplars = 1,966,006 B) is the **WORST** exemplar arm, **19 points below a store 30× smaller.** ⭐ ***Recency IS the hidden temperature variable***: a 500-example window spans ≈0.13 °C of a 20 °C sweep, i.e. it *is* the per-temperature classifier Souza measured at 90 % vs 84 % pooled. SAM-kNN discovers this itself (STM averages **945** of a permitted 3,000; LTM selected as predictor on **14,149 / 79,986 = 17.7 %** of instances), and **ARF is a recency mechanism here too — 78 of its 100 trees hold exactly one node at the end of the pass** (616 nodes total). **On INSECTS the winning strategy is *forget fast*.**

Standardisation is worth **+4.0 to +6.3 points** (SAM-kNN 5000: **71.52 raw → 76.92 std**). ⛔⛔ **Had the analyst run raw only, `criterion4_cleared` would have come out TRUE.**

### N296 — ⛔⛔ (benchmarking methodology, independently useful) Plain prequential at an h-step horizon LEAKS up to h−1 hours of future labels — and the leak is ASYMMETRIC IN THE DIRECTION OF FIRING  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✯) · all (evaluation protocol; the paper-facing methodology product of the wave)

- **Tried:** running an h = 24-hour-ahead stream under the ordinary test-then-train prequential protocol — which the analyst's **own pre-registration** asserted was leak-free *"because pair `j`'s features stop at `j−24` and its label is revealed only after prediction."*
- **What is wrong with that (mechanism, verbatim):** pair `t−1`'s **label** is the traffic volume at target time `j−1` — **23 hours after pair `t`'s forecast origin `j−24`**. ⇒ plain test-then-train hands a **continuously-updated** learner up to **23 h of future traffic**, and it does so **asymmetrically**: a k-NN store that admits every new pair immediately gains from it; a GBDT refit every 720 pairs does not. **Fix implemented and used for every primary number: `A(t) =` index of the last pair whose *target* time ≤ pair `t`'s *origin* time** (`searchsorted(tgt, tgt−24, 'right') − 1`; median `t − A(t)` = 24, mean 22.86, max 24); every store, fit and online update restricted to indices ≤ `A(t)`.
- **Numbers (verbatim, `c2w10-metro-gate` §3.5 + `METRO-GATE.json → protocol_correction_24h_label_embargo.delta_table`, full 45-arm table):** k-NN L=250 std **398.17 leaky → 446.64 embargoed = +10.85 %** · k-NN L=250 raw 373.00 → 407.90 = +8.56 % · k-NN L=1,007 std 344.28 → 363.59 = +5.31 % · k-NN L=5,037 raw 312.06 → 320.98 = +2.78 % · k-NN L=14,894 raw 300.42 → 306.76 = +2.07 % · **`gbdt` 339.80 → 338.65 = −0.34 %** · `mlp` 420.27 → 414.97 = −1.28 %. **The verdict is unchanged by the fix** (leaky within-protocol `margin_rel` −0.0946; embargoed **−0.0615**) — ⭐ **the embargo REDUCES the exemplar store's advantage by ~3 points of relative MAE, i.e. the analyst closed a leak that was biased toward firing its own tripwire.**
- **And its companion, a second protocol defect in the same registration:** ⛔ **`seasonal-naive(t−24 h)` is DEGENERATE at a 24-h horizon — bit-identical to persistence, measured max |diff| = 0.0** (predicted as P4 and confirmed exactly). **The non-degenerate naive is `t−168 h` (weekly), MAE 342.6513** — and it is the one that decides criterion 2 (N295).
- **Scope / limits:** measured on one stream (Metro, 34,848 pairs, hourly, h = 24) with one feature construction; the **mechanism** is protocol-general for any h-step-ahead stream with a continuously-updated learner, the **magnitudes** are not. ⚠ Two further harness defects declared beside it: a causal z-score blow-up (standardised values to 1.0e6 at t < 500 ⇒ a GRU emitting 7.7e6; fixed by a declared **±10 SD clip** on every standardised arm, **the pre-fix number reported and used nowhere**), and `rls_ff` (RLS with forgetting factor 0.999) **diverging** (RMSE 5.3e4 then 2.3e5) ⇒ excluded and declared NOT-RUN.
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **Filed by Head ruling (§A41.3) as INDEPENDENTLY USEFUL BENCHMARKING METHODOLOGY, not merely as a wave detail** — the artifact the paper-writer mines when any h-step-ahead stream appears. **Proposed standing practice (analyst's recommendation 4, ⚠ NOT yet adopted): compute `A(t)` and publish the leak-delta table for any h-step-ahead stream — three lines, and it caught a 10.9 % artifact inside a pre-registered protocol.** ⭐⭐ **Transferable form: *a protocol claim in a prereg is a hypothesis about the protocol, and it is falsifiable like any other* — this one was falsified by its own author, mid-run, and both protocols were reported.**

### N297 — ⛔ I2 returns INDETERMINATE at the live-well count that was supposed to settle it — and the MECHANISM was never exercised at all: the deferral checked the COUNT and never the CHANNEL  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✯) · memory-architecture (instrument + Advisor scoping erratum)

- **Tried:** Add.7 ruling 5's deferred I2 re-measurement (does usefulness predict erosion?) at the persistent-store rig, with the registered two-sided lift rule, ICC beside every correlation, and erosion measured on the **netted, log-scale** curve.
- **Numbers (verbatim, `c2w10-i2-usage-erosion` §3/§4 + `I2-VERDICT.json`; seeds 0/1/2):** **I2-a POWER PASS** — `n_live_max` **64 / 64 / 64**, `n_live_end` 63/63/63, **scored n = 57 / 60 / 57** after the ≥4-readings rule ⇒ **detectable |ρ| = 0.272 / 0.265 / 0.272**. **I2-b ICC PASS 3/3** — `ICC(1,1)` of `read_hits` = **+0.2797 / +0.4466 / +0.4665** (unlike C2W6's negative ICC), split-half 0.395/0.638/0.573, attenuation ceiling **0.592 / 0.732 / 0.668**. **I2-c:** `ρ(U, E_netted)` = **−0.2396 / −0.2834 / −0.3246**, 2-SE uppers **+0.0278 / −0.0265 / −0.0646**, perm p (20 k) 0.0735 / 0.0286 / 0.0143 ⇒ ⛔ **CONFIRM fires 0/3** (it needs the upper bound below −0.20). **I2-d:** `ρ(U, depth_netted)` = **−0.0361 / +0.1033 / +0.0201**, every CI straddling zero ⇒ **leg 2 fails 3/3**. ⇒ **`branch = "INDETERMINATE"`, `lift_rule_satisfied = false`** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **the §A23.5 depth-as-feature-importance caveat STAYS EXACTLY WHERE IT IS.** Censoring **0.000 / 0.000 / 0.000** (min netted depth 0.294 / 0.738 / 0.321).

### N298 — ⭐⭐ (PROPOSED standing instrument rule, ⛔ NOT adopted) RELIABILITY IS NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT — a proxy split-halved at 0.78–0.89 while BEING four ULP of float32 round-off  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✯) · memory-architecture (instrument validity; the twin of C2W6's *"ICC ≤ 0 ⇒ UNDEFINED"*)

- **Tried:** validating the undesigned-erosion proxy `E_netted` the way C2W6's lesson prescribes — by its **reliability** — and pre-registering that a float-noise quantity would **not** reproduce (`P-4`: split-half ≤ 0.20).
- **Numbers (verbatim, `c2w10-i2-usage-erosion` §3.3/§3.6, PREREG scorecard P-3/P-4):** ⛔ **P-4 REFUTED: split-half reliability of `E_netted` = 0.885 / 0.839 / 0.778** — *highly* reliable. And the quantity it measures so reliably: **median netted total log-drop over a whole 48-chunk run = 4.81e-07 / 3.98e-07 / 4.49e-07 nats** against **0.580 / 0.590 / 0.620 nats raw** ⇒ **ratio 6.95e-7 / 6.77e-7 / 6.77e-7**, i.e. **a netted span of ~4 float32 ULP** (median 4.12 / 3.65 / 3.77 ULP, max 6.79 / 6.74 / 6.53); median `|E_net|` **1.85e-8 / 1.62e-8 / 1.65e-8** nats/chunk; **54/58/57 wells show netted INCREASES as well as decreases** — the signature of round-off, not of physics. **Mechanism: the ULP residual is deterministic and item-specific, so it split-halves beautifully while being physically meaningless.** Corroborating hygiene from the same section: raw curves are **monotone non-increasing on every well of every seed** (`n_items_with_any_raw_increase = 0/0/0`, max raw `final/min` = 1.000), so no C2W6-style trough exists here to be mistaken for decay.
- **The proposed rule, verbatim (Hub-proposed at close, ADVISOR-FACING — filed here as PROPOSED, ⛔ not as adopted):**
  > **Reliability is necessary but not sufficient.** `E_netted`'s split-half reliability was **0.78–0.89** while the quantity itself was **≈4 ULP of float32 round-off** (netted log-drop **4e-7 nats** vs **0.58–0.62 nats** raw, ratio **6.8e-7**). ⇒ every erosion/usage proxy carries **two** checks: **(a) reliability** (ICC / split-half) **and (b) magnitude against the designed channel**; **a proxy at ≤ 1e-6 of the designed channel is UNDEFINED regardless of its reliability.**
- **Two consequences attached, both concrete:** ⛔ **any future undesigned-erosion cell runs the store amplitudes in FLOAT64** — at float32 the netted channel saturates at ~4 ULP, i.e. **the instrument's noise floor sits above any effect it could see**; and ⚠ **§5's detection floor is 0.272 / 0.265 / 0.272, not the registered "≈ 0.25"** (`n_live = 64` is transient — `n_live_end = 63` on 3/3 — and the ≥4-readings rule scores 57/60/57). ⚠ **The floor correction makes AMENDMENT 6's power defect slightly WORSE, not better: clearing `hi_2se ≤ −0.20` needed ρ ≈ −0.47.**
- **Scope / limits:** one rig, one dtype, one proxy, 3 seeds — ⛔ **the RULE is a proposal about instruments, not a measurement about stores**, and the Advisor owns whether it becomes standing. ⚠ It is the *instrument* reason I2-d could not fire here, **distinct from** N297's *channel* reason (no outer objective) — the two are independent and both hold.
- **Disposition:** ⚖ **PROPOSED, Advisor-owned, not adopted by the Hub and not by the curator.** ⭐⭐ **The transferable sentence: *a measurement can be perfectly repeatable and still be nothing* — repeatability tells you the instrument is stable, not that it is pointed at anything.** ⭐ **Filed beside its twin (C2W6: `ICC ≤ 0 ⇒ UNDEFINED`, N229/N231) so the pair is read together: one rules out an unreliable proxy, the other rules out a reliable one that measures round-off.**

### N301 — ⛔ The protected set never accumulates and the trash population is partly *unreachable* rather than useless — two measured limits on the lifecycle that shipped  · tier B (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✯) · memory-architecture (lifecycle mechanics; scope of a green build)

- **Tried:** running the three-state lifecycle **PROTECTED ⇄ ACTIVE → TRASH** (all seven legs green, `lifecycle_mechanics_done = true` computed in code as the AND over pytest exit statuses, kill-conditions committed **before** the verbs at `162fdba`: **32 failed, 1 passed** against a stub, then **34 passed**) on the synthetic regime-switcher, and reading what the verbs actually did on a stream rather than on planted populations.
- **⛔ L4 is UNEXERCISED (K-C applied, and it is not a pass):** `protected_cap = floor(0.25 × 64) = 16` while the measured protected population **peaked at 3 / 1 / 3 wells** ⇒ `n_promote_refused = 0` on every seed and **`protected_saturation` never tripped on the stream.** The verb is green on the planted population (the negative *and* its can-fail twin: `f_max := 1.0` ⇒ everything protects and nothing trips), so the leg lands — **what is absent is a stream population that reaches the bound.** ⛔ **Reported as UNEXERCISED — not working and not broken.**
- **Why (mechanism, measurable rather than mysterious): promotion/demotion churn is ≈ 1:1** — **60 promotions vs 53 demotions** across 3 seeds (27/13/20 and 24/12/17), with the item-level pattern visible in the log (seed 0 item 22: promoted at chunks 10, 15, 36; demoted at 11, 18, 38). The asymmetric hysteresis works exactly as registered (promotion sticky, `d_dwell = 3 > window = 2`; demotion prompt, `d_demote = 2`) — **but at this read budget usage is bursty on a 2-chunk timescale, so the protected set never accumulates.** ⇒ ⚖ **if the wave wants protection to STICK, `d_demote` must exceed the usage's burst gap — a parameter decision for the Hub, not a defect and not a spoke's call.**
- **⚠ And the trash verb's target set is not a pure never-useful set:** L3 routed **117 items** (37/42/38, `trash_bytes` 2220/2520/2280 B) keyed on **item-id `read_hits`, never depth** — so **Q4 is CONFIRMED (prior 0.45) and K-C does NOT fire for L3** — **but 48–55 % of reads land in no basin at all** (`n_unassigned` **3225 / 3297 / 2926 of 6016**) because `covered` is a **launch-point** test. **A well never covered is never credited**, so part of the trashed population is *"never reachable by this read"*, not *"never useful"*. ⇒ **`read_coverage` (0.464 / 0.452 / 0.514) travels with every usage number and is the ceiling on the proxy's resolution.**
- **⭐ The designed negatives that DID bite, recorded because they are the point:** **L2's rich-get-richer negative passes** — a planted early-popular-then-abandoned well **demotes within `d_demote` and is NOT trashed** (53 demotion events on the stream), and it fails on the named mutation (`demote := False` ⇒ it stays PROTECTED forever). **L3** ships three negatives including the **censoring guard** (a well admitted in the last stream is never trashed; `censoring_guard := False` ⇒ the young well **is** trashed). **L7 OFF is bit-identical AND parameter-count-identical** (`n_params = 492 493`, `trash_attached = false`, `trash_bytes = 0`). ⭐ **Every designed negative ships with the NAMED MUTATION that makes it fail** — the answer to the defect class C2W8 caught twice.
- **⭐ The drift-free control, and the correct MECHANICS reading of it:** promote/demote/trash **22 / 21 / 37** with regime switching OFF against seed 0's **27 / 24 / 37** ⇒ **the lifecycle verbs behave the same with and without regime switching** — *the verbs are driven by usage, and usage is a property of the address stream, not of the label map.* ⛔ **This is NOT a VALUE control and no retention/adaptation quantity was computed.**
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **synthetic substrate = a MECHANICS instrument, never a claim venue (§A14.8)**; 3 seeds; `m = 1`; ⛔ **the REAL-stream legs are a DECLARED NOT-RUN** (`BENCHMARK-GATE.json` did not exist when the build ran — the loader, sha256 gate, decimation refusal and structure assertions ship and are pytest-pinned on the synthetic, and a missing gate file is handled as a NOT-RUN rather than a crash). Byte ledger per cell: `clu_store 1,969,920 B` + `codebook 3,024 B` + `φ params 484 B` + `trash_bytes` ⇒ **1,975,648 / 1,975,948 / 1,975,708 B ≈ 1.884 MiB.** Monitors: **`vacuous_gate`** (seeds 0, 2) and **#12 `starvation`** (3/3) tripped — the same pair C2W8 saw on this substrate; the new **`protected_saturation`** row (severity II) is reported by name on every cell and did not trip.
- **Disposition:** ⭐ **The lifecycle BANKS as mechanics and is quotable as such** (Add.14 §A39.3 / §A41.2), and it ships as a component ready for a compositional rig: usage-gated promotion with hysteresis, **demotion = re-exposure to designed decay (⛔ NEVER the trash region)**, `read_hits`-keyed trash, a bounded protected fraction, netting on every depth curve. ⚠ **Carry the rider-3 watch item with it: `U` is not independent of depth (`ρ(U, depth_raw) ≈ +0.19`, ICC(U) 0.28–0.47), so a `read_hits`-keyed trash criterion has a MILD DEPTH ENDOGENEITY — a watch item, not a defect, closable by a 1-line census check (`ρ(read_hits, depth_raw)` per seed).**

### N302 — ⭐⭐ THE WAVE'S SENTENCE: the organizer-swap question is UNASKABLE at `d_addr = 4`, and the block is BOUNDED with a NAMED DIAL — measured twice, by two blind spokes, on two instruments  · tier A (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✰) · memory-architecture (tier-ii scope bound; the C3 design input)

- **Tried:** asking charter §A33.2's tier-ii VALUE question (generalization / calibration / navigability under the organizer swap) on the repaired substrate, after K0 lifted the C2W5 occupancy cap 26×.
- **The bound, from two independent instruments run by two spokes blind to each other:** the **best bijective re-placement of wells onto cue sites — the ceiling on ANY placement organizer** (exact linear-assignment optimum on the label-free co-occurrence matrix) = **0.3290 ± 0.0074** (spoke B); the **recomputed combinatorial decodability of the launch points** = **0.3449 ± 0.0175** (spoke C). Launch-head identity precision **0.2439 ± 0.0227**; row-max (unachievable) bound 0.3818 ± 0.0075; expected correct wells at the ceiling **1.316 ± 0.029 of 4**.
- **Why it forecloses BOTH arms:** exact-set needs ~4/4 wells (a missing payload contributes `‖v_j‖ = 0.60 > tol ≈ 0.287`). Even at the unachievable row-max under optimistic independence, exact-set ≈ 0.3818⁴ ≈ **0.021 — 2.4× below V1's 0.0504 bar**; at the achievable ceiling ≈ 0.012 (4.3× short); at identity ≈ 0.0035. ⇒ ⛔ **No placement of wells lifts EITHER arm over the bar at this read protocol — both are floored by the same cap, so the swap compares nothing.**
- **Mechanism, measured not asserted:** spoke C's collision control (declared out-of-class) shows the ceiling is **structural, not noise** — noiseless-launch **0.3424** vs as-launched **0.3372** (σ_q costs 0.005); **~2/3 of unseen combinations deflate to a pick-tuple another combination also produces**. ⛔ **A smaller σ_q cannot buy it back**; the greedy matched-filter deflation at `d_addr = 4` is the cap.
- **Corroboration from the null side:** `null*` = **0.001953125** (N2; N3 ties) over **594 configs × 5 seeds**, 25.8× below the bar, with L1–L4 all passing — ⭐ **N1 at 1.0000 train / 0.00078 unseen** with 28 672 free floats and the *identical* store parameterisation: it memorises perfectly and composes not at all. ### N313 — ⚠ Four specification and measurement defects the build surfaced, three of them in registrations the Hub itself wrote  · tier C (CURATOR-PROPOSED ✯) · all (process / spec hygiene)

- **(1) ⛔ L3's registered wording and its own designed negative are NOT JOINTLY SATISFIABLE.** The registration says *"never useful **since first appearance** over `k` stream boundaries"*, while designed negative (a) says *"useful in stream 1 only ⇒ trashed at `k`"* — **an item useful in stream 1 is not never-useful-since-first-appearance**, so (a) can only fire under a **trailing-window** reading. ✅ **Both readings SHIP, the default is declared (`last_k_streams`), and the difference is pytest-asserted** (`test_l3_the_two_readings_of_the_criterion_differ_and_both_ship`) so it cannot be silently resolved later. ⚖ **Which reading §A20.6 intends is an open Hub/Advisor ratification.**
- **(2) ⚠ L4's demotion timing could not be scored on the trailing window without falsifying its own wording.** *"PROTECTED → ACTIVE **within `d_demote`** chunks"* is false as written under a window of length `W`: the last pre-abandonment hits carry forward `W−1` further chunks, delaying demotion to **`W−1+d_demote`** (measured: **3 chunks** at `W=2, d_demote=2`). ✅ **Demotion is therefore scored on the chunk's own hits while promotion keeps the window — promotion sticky, demotion prompt — and it is the only version in which the rich-get-richer negative bites.** ⭐ **A guard-validity result rides with it: a single burst satisfies the trailing-window test for exactly `window` chunks, so the hysteresis binds — and the burst negative can fail at all — IFF `d_dwell > window`; with `d_dwell ≤ window` the designed negative is *arithmetically incapable of failing* (the vacuous-guard defect class). This is now a `ValueError` at construction, not a comment.**
- **(3) ⚠ The L6 netting tolerance was over-specified by a dtype.** The registered *"nets to analytic `exp(−leak·Δt)` to **1e-9**"* holds only in **float64**; the shipped store's amplitudes are **float32** and the achievable floor is **≈5.3e-8**. **Both are pinned** (P4-a scored **PARTIALLY REFUTED** — *the residual risk the prereg named is the one that fired*). ⛔ **Any future prereg quoting 1e-9 must name the dtype.** ⚠ **And the assertion was dtype-INHERITED: run alone it is float32 and the negative assertion is correct; after any module that enables `jax_enable_x64` the same store is float64, the bound holds, and a correct negative assertion goes RED — green alone, red in the suite, the exact §7.23 ordering class C2W8 recorded twice.** Fixed at `6e0c325` by pinning the flag **function-scoped** (a module-scoped x64 fixture is itself the N211 hazard) and restoring it in a `finally`.
- **(4) ⚠ Two carried numbers did not reproduce, continuing N273 / N285.** The base test count at `9e0bb25` **in a fresh worktree is 1564 collected / 1562 selected**, not the task file's **1555** (branch tip `6e0c325`: 1633 collected / 1631 selected; **1564 + 69 = 1633 ✓**, and the wave's own integration checkout gives 1612/1610 → 1679, **+69**, in **one** checkout). And the carried operating point **`d_safe_frac = 0.88` reaches `n_live` 64 / 52 / 64 — only 2/3 seeds** ⇒ the I2 spoke's per-seed `n_live ≥ 64` precondition needed **0.60**; ⭐ **the engineer left the config default at 0.88 and ran with an explicit override rather than silently moving a carried default** — the Hub owns whether to move it.
- **Scope / limits:** ⛔ **No verdict moves on any of the four**; (1) and (2) change *which* wells are trashed and *when* demotion is scored, not whether the verbs work. ⚠ Items (1)–(3) are defects in registrations the Hub wrote, filed by the spoke against its own task.
- **Disposition:** ⭐⭐ **STANDING (and the wave earned it twice): a designed negative that cannot fail arithmetically is not a negative — check the parameter inequality that makes it able to fail, and enforce it at CONSTRUCTION.** ⭐ **Standing (continuing N273/N285): test counts are comparable only WITHIN one checkout; state the checkout with the number.**

### N315 — ⚠ (registry hygiene, curator process, self-filed) TWO curator folds on ADJACENT waves allocated the SAME N-numbers — and the second-order damage was a CORRECT citation struck as if it were wrong  · tier C (CURATOR-PROPOSED ⟡) · all (registry hygiene; the standing fix is one line of protocol)

- **Tried:** two doc-curator folds writing into this registry within ~36 hours of each other, each taking its N-range from *"the then-maximum N, verified collision-free at end of pass"* — the C2W11 fold (fold symbol **✰**, filed 2026-08-12 by `doc-curator-c2w11-c2-close`, `N302–N312`) and the C2W10 fold (fold symbol **✯**, filed 2026-08-11 by `doc-curator-c2w10-fold`, `N294–N303`).
- **Exact numbers.** The registry carried **TWO `### N302` and TWO `### N303`** entries: C2W11's `N302 ✰` (the launch-head bound: `0.3290 ± 0.0074` · `0.3449 ± 0.0175`) and `N303 ✰` (the store's exoneration: oracle-addressed exact-set `0.8621 ± 0.0036`), against C2W10's `N302 ✯` (four specification/measurement defects) and `N303 ✯` (the prereg scorecard). **Live citation counts at ruling time** — `claims_matrix.md`: N302 **24**, N303 **12** · `handover_context.md`: 2 / 3 · `future_work.md`: 4 / 1 · `c3-handover.md`: 1 / — · `advisor-head-c3-charter.md`: — / — (and **N312** appears there once, C3 Add.1 §4) ⇒ the **C2W11 ✰ block is load-bearing across FIVE live documents including the C3 charter**, while the C2W10 ✯ pair's only external pointer was **primer record 11.29**.
- **Why it failed (mechanism, and it is not carelessness):** the collision-avoidance protocol both folds followed is *"take numbers after the then-maximum and verify collision-free **at end of pass**."* That check is **read-then-write with no reservation in between** — a classic lost-update: fold A reads max = N293 and writes N294–N303 over hours; fold B reads max = N301 (fold A's block only partly on disk / a stale file view) and writes N302–N312. **Both passes' end-of-pass checks can pass against the file each one saw.** The C2W6/C2W7 folds hit the same class earlier (`N231`) and resolved it by one fold **shifting its block**, which worked only because the collision was detected *during* the write.
- **The second-order damage, and it is the more instructive half.** At the C2W11 close fold the curator struck primer record 11.29's citation *"registry N297 / N298 / **N302 / N303**"* on the reasoning that those numbers *"did NOT exist when this record was filed and now resolve to entries on a DIFFERENT subject."* ⛔ **The first half of that reasoning was WRONG:** they were a **FORWARD REFERENCE** to entries the C2W10 fold subsequently filed, and those entries **are** on-topic for that record. ⇒ **a correct citation was struck because a numbering collision made it look incorrect.** ✅ **Restored 2026-08-13 to `N297 / N298 / N313 / N314`** with a replacement dated annotation.
- **Scope of the negative:** ⛔ **a process/hygiene negative only — NO scientific verdict, tier, number or wording moves anywhere**, in either campaign. ⚠ It is a statement about **concurrent curator folds**, not about spokes or the Hub; the same hazard exists for any append-only registry written by more than one agent per wave. ⚠ **It is the THIRD instance of the class** (C2W6/C2W7 `N231`; this pair; and the near-miss disclosed in the C2W10 fold header, *"the Hub should diff-check that exactly one N294…N303 exists"* — the check was requested and the diff was not run until the C2W11 matrix fold flagged it).
- **Disposition:** ⭐⭐ **STANDING FIX, adopted as curator protocol from this pass: a fold RESERVES its N-range in the registry header BEFORE it writes its first entry** — one dated line naming the fold, its symbol and its claimed range (`Nxxx–Nyyy, RESERVED, fold symbol ⟡`), written and saved first, so a concurrent fold reads a reservation rather than a maximum. ⭐ **Corollary, and the reason the fix is cheap: the reservation is the only artifact that has to be written before the work; the end-of-pass collision check stays, but it becomes a confirmation rather than the sole defense.** ⭐ **Second standing rule, from the second-order damage: ⛔ never strike a citation on the inference *"those numbers did not exist yet"* — in an append-only registry that is exactly what a FORWARD REFERENCE looks like; check the subject matter, and if it matches, the citation is live.** ⚖ **Resolution executed:** `N302 ✯ → N313`, `N303 ✯ → N314` (Hub ruling 2026-08-13, minimal-damage direction), C2W11's ✰ pair untouched, primer 11.29 restored. **Source: this pass's own ruling record — `.claude/tasks/c2w11-claims-matrix-fold.md` Part C · `.claude/outputs/c2w11-claims-matrix-fold.md` · the v2.16 flag in `claims_matrix.md` that surfaced it.**
